### Verdict Confirmation

**No new blockers are introduced, and the design-only verdict remains unchanged.**

Changing the final sentence of the roadmap section in [README.md](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/README.md#L258-L259) from *"removing Tokio is not a committed direction"* to *"replacing Tokio for async applications is not a committed direction"* removes a potential ambiguity with Milestone 2 (**Tokio-free thread builds**) and aligns the wording directly with [docs/ROADMAP.md](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/docs/ROADMAP.md#L81) (*"This does not commit Spawned to replacing Tokio for async applications"*).

- **Remaining Blockers**: None.
- **Scope**: This confirms **design and API-contract documentation consistency only**. It does not constitute approval of implementation code, test suites, or production rollout.
